about_the_game:
Learn to survive on a planet inhabited only by broken robots that don’t like humans. In this game, you’ll uncover the history of the planet and all its inhabitants. Gather resources, repair and upgrade machinery, and craft complex tools to build your own farm and explore a fascinating, unique world filled with mysteries waiting to be discovered.

Upgrade buildings and items to venture deeper into the planet and uncover all its hidden secrets. You can crossbreed plants to grow an unusual garden, go fishing for robo-fish, and master a variety of technologies. Take care of animals, repair robots from the junkyard city, and find your place on a planet where you’re the only human.

Gather resources

Forge your path on the planet. Venture deeper and deeper for valuable resources essential for survival. Create tools to aid your journey: from a pickaxe, fishing rod, and shovel to an exoskeleton, laser, and rockets. Upgrade your equipment and arsenal with advanced tools: assemble helpers from parts to automate resource collection, garden care, animal tending, and other tasks. Level up your technology and unlock new items to improve your experience on this harsh planet.

Explore a new world

Journey into the depths of the planet, filled with intriguing stories and mysteries. Encounter crazed robots, hidden factories, and secret experiments, along with bio-robots unknown to science. Discover more about this amazing planet and unlock the secrets it holds. Build an exoskeleton, venture into the planet’s depths, overcome every obstacle in your path, and uncover all its mysteries.

Build. Create. Innovate

Build your own cyber farm using a variety of materials and tools. It could be a garden with unique plants or a fully automated farm—the choice is yours! Customize your character's appearance and equip them with a wide range of items and outfits to suit your style.

Socialize in the robot community

Help local robots in their difficult life by completing tasks for different communities, become their friend. You are the only one who can repair old, broken robots. By developing your robot repair point, you will not only be able to return to working condition and improve functioning robot inhabitants. You will also be able to return those who have long been completely broken, bring them back to life, and increase the inhabitants of the beautiful robot city, receiving new opportunities!

Fight against robots

The planet is inhabited by countless crazed machines. Use your combat skills to defeat numerous robots and mechanisms. Invest resources in new weapon technologies and plan a strategy to break through the robot hordes. Valuable rare parts obtained in battle will aid you on your adventure and help you gather the precious energy you need.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+) or Windows 10
  • Processor: intel core i5, 1.5 GHz and up
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1 Gb dedicated video card, shader model 3.0+
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Survive on a junkyard planet filled with broken robots, machinery, and resources in this adventure sandbox game. Recycle resources, repair robots, invent items, create new plant species, grow them, and uncover the mysteries of this planet.
supported_languages:
English*, Russian*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Norwegian, Portuguese - Portugal
*languages with full audio support
